title: SaaS exit readiness buyer-safe handoff template
purpose: Structure a redacted fit-review request before any credential, production export or regulated-data discussion.

fields.name: decision_question
fields.prompt: What renewal, exit or replacement decision is being considered?

fields.name: safe_evidence_summary
fields.prompt: What was checked, by whom and in what safe test context?

fields.name: unresolved_boundary
fields.prompt: What is unavailable, sensitive or still unverified?

fields.name: reversible_next_step
fields.prompt: What bounded review can happen without changing production?

stop_rule: If the next step requires sensitive access before fit is established, hold and request a narrower scope.
claim_boundary: Educational vendor-exit planning only; not customer proof, legal advice, compliance advice, security advice, procurement advice or a guarantee.
